options.label: Automatic lockpicking
options.tooltip: Lets idle companions use keys or their Open Lock skill on eligible nearby doors and containers outside combat.

options.label: Search radius
options.tooltip: Sets the maximum distance from the player at which locked doors and containers are considered for automatic lockpicking.

options.label: Lock target priority
options.tooltip: Chooses the nearest available target or the hardest target a companion can handle. Detected active traps always take priority over untrapped locks.

options.label: Lock interval
options.tooltip: Sets how often line of sight and active lockpicking tasks are checked. Lower values react faster but perform more checks.

options.label: Require line of sight
options.tooltip: Restricts automatic lockpicking to locks that the player can currently see.

options.label: Prevent attacks on worked locks
options.tooltip: Stops companions from attacking locks or traps that the party is unlocking or disarming, even when automatic lockpicking is disabled.

options.label: Highlight targets
options.tooltip: Applies a grey visual highlight to eligible locks detected by Companion Manager.

options.label: Show overhead messages
options.tooltip: Shows a short overhead message when a companion claims a lockpicking task.

options.label: Enable diagnostics
options.tooltip: Writes lock scans, available locksmiths, assignments, and pathing diagnostics to the message log.
